column1: Bridge - from the case's Year-1 economic value to the adjusted value (Rp billion)
Each step is a formula; the last rows check that the bridge ties to the Model sheet.
Case as written: total economic value Year 1
1. Remove capacity value counted as cash (non-cash, double-counted with visits avoided)
2. Remove contact-saving credits that contradict the revenue lift (retail partly kept)
3. Apply lift realization (ranking lift is not causal lift)
4. Convert revenue to risk-adjusted contribution (drawn share, balance, credit cost, opex)
5. Apply in-year earning factor (cohort originated through the year)
6. Less: Year-1 outlay (case Rp 22.7B, adjusted for missing cost items)
Check: difference vs Model sheet (should be 0)
